actors.name: Vân Nha · Liệt Nha
actors.description: Two curved ivory fang strokes condense around a narrow celadon breath ribbon. Charge: two small fangs sharpen in an inward spiral. Release: one strong forward crescent with TWO interlocking fang notches and wind filaments, crisp dark teal edges. Impact: two fang-shaped slash marks split into three short ivory spikes and jade dust. NO literal wolf head.

actors.name: Mộc Phù · Xuyên Diệp
actors.description: An ochre rectangular talisman hangs inside a ring of four pointed jade LEAVES, with a twisted root stroke. Charge: leaves rotate inward around paper seal. Release: a green thorn lance wrapped in a corkscrew of four leaves, narrow bright ivory core, separated dark root curls. Impact: a sharp sprouting branch lattice opens with leaf-shaped shards, no generic star explosion.

actors.name: Ngọc Giáp · Song Kiềm
actors.description: TWO opposed crescent PINCER shapes, aged bronze outside and teal crystalline inside. Charge: small pair opens and clamps inward around a diamond jade spark. Release: pincers snap together making a clear crossed X of two thick angular cuts. Impact: a broken diamond jade facet and warm bronze chips fly apart. No beast anatomy, only abstract pincer energy.

actors.name: Mặc Dực · Tước Ảnh
actors.description: Two ragged violet-black paper WING strokes with cool lavender ivory razor edges. Charge: paired black feathers pull into a small violet bead. Release: a swept V-shaped ink dive wake pointing right, two torn ribbons and thin luminous violet outer blades. Impact: four separated ink petals burst with a tiny violet-white center. Strong opaque dark contour behind luminous edge, no smoke cloud covering the action.

actors.name: Khôi Ấn · Chấn Thạch
actors.description: An angular SQUARE bronze stamp, cracked jade stone corners, warm amber energy. Charge: four heavy square corners gather around a tiny seal. Release: square stamp compresses into a heavy forward trapezoid shock stroke with stone chips and gold-white crack lines. Impact: a square broken seal splits in four with chunky jade slabs, brief radial shock wave. Mechanical heaviness, no fist/body/weapon.

actors.name: Thực Linh · Tán Bào
actors.description: Saffron-ivory SPORE beads and muted moss green mist, distinct rounded organic shape. Charge: six small seed beads spiral inward. Release: circular low expanding ring made of pearl spores, dense bright rim and dark olive underside, fully open hollow center. Impact: three bell-shaped spore clusters pop into smaller amber droplets and pale seed stars. Row2 radial centered, NOT directional.

actors.name: Hắc Phù · Liệt Ấn
actors.description: ONE cream rectangular PAPER talisman with earth-red angular abstract seal, dark plum ink tail. Charge: folded paper rotates within a red angular sigil. Release: one bright talisman spear pointing right with paired red hook strokes and two ink ribbons, keep paper silhouette readable. Impact: paper cracks into triangular cream fragments within a red broken square seal. No readable text or Chinese characters.

actors.name: U Niệm · Nhiếp Hồn
actors.description: A hollow cyan jade LANTERN flame enclosed by two charcoal ink curves, not the creature body. Charge: small hollow teardrop and wisps orbit inward. Release: long hollow spectral flame spear pointing right, white-blue double rim, two separated dark curls with little cyan pearls. Impact: hollow cyan iris ring collapses then splits into four curved soul shards. No literal eyeball/face/body.

actors.name: Lang Tuần · Phong Nha Trận
actors.description: ELITE wolf: three long ivory-celadon FANG blades around a broken circular wind sigil, deeper blue ink contour. Charge: three curved fangs orbit a bright three-pronged wind crest, ring closes in stages. Release: three offset thick forward claw-like fang blades in a fan with a braided wind helix, spatial silhouette clearly different from normal single crescent. Impact: triple slash and a large broken wind-ring ripple with crisp ivory fangs, jade chips. Spiritual predator, no wolf face.

actors.name: Thiết Giáp · Trấn Ngọc Kiềm
actors.description: ELITE insect: two massive angular BRONZE JADE mandible energy blades surrounding a diamond armor sigil. Charge: diamond plates stack inward with a bronze ring and two pincer tips. Release: two serrated armor crescents snap across a sharp diamond core, thick gold-white outer edge, deep teal jade plates; upward rock splinters. Impact: diamond shield sigil SHATTERS with a four-way fault line, gold rim and large angular jade pieces. This is heavy armor energy, not a recolored normal claw.

actors.name: Hắc Lụa · Tam Phù Liên Ấn
actors.description: ELITE spellcaster: exactly THREE luminous cream paper seals linked into a triangular formation by red threads and dark violet silk ribbons. Charge: three paper seals unfold sequentially around a small triangle, ring of red geometric runic strokes. Release: three stepped paper-seal lances pointing right at different vertical levels, connected by a triangular red frame and opaque black-violet ribbons. Impact: three paper sigils ignite in sequence around a broken red-violet triangle and detach as cream fragments. Keep geometric triangle and three-seal hierarchy; no generic spark, no readable text.
